decided.ownCards: the statement selects rows whose subject column is the caller; a row with an intact body is then left out when actor() refuses it (creator, access view or policy differ: 403)

decided.integrity: inconsistent when the body fails the card schema, its own fingerprint or resolver, the row object_key/artifact_hash linkage, or the linkage to its executed plan; such a row is listed only after the subject column and the plan reader admitted the caller, the same access the consistency report asks for
decided.unknownScopeOrTarget: a scope that is not the stored snapshot is the house 409 (USP_MANIFEST_REFRESH or USP_SCOPE_STALE, readManifest); an unknown target in a known scope is 200 with no items
